title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
**About Acme Interiors**

Acme Interiors is a leading Design and Build and General Contracting company in the interior fit-out industry, with a track record of more than 30 years.

**Position Overview**

The Desktop Support Engineer provides first-line technical support to employees across Acme Interiors, keeping desktops, laptops, peripherals, networks and business applications running smoothly. The role installs, configures and troubleshoots hardware and software, supports users clearly and promptly, and follows IT security and backup practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows 8.1, 10 and 11 Pro systems, including user permissions

* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network and peripheral issues for employees

* Install, configure and support common business and design software applications

* Support basic LAN/WAN connectivity, including router and switch configuration where required

* Maintain antivirus, firewall and general security best practices on user systems

* Perform backups and recovery procedures as per IT policy

* Support users on cloud services such as M365 and other cloud platforms

* Log, track and close support requests within agreed timelines, and escalate to the IT Manager where required

* Maintain IT asset records and documentation of issues and fixes

**Technical Skills Required**

1. Basic Networking: Understanding of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic router/switch configurations

2. Operating Systems: Windows 8.1, 10, 11 Pro installation and configuration, troubleshooting, permissions

3. Hardware Knowledge: Familiarity with computer hardware components, assembly, and troubleshooting

4. Software Installation and Management: Ability to install, configure, and troubleshoot common software applications

5. Security Fundamentals: Basic understanding of firewalls, antivirus software, and general security best practices

6. Backup and Recovery: Knowledge of backup solutions and recovery procedures

7. Basic Cloud Computing: Introduction to cloud services like M365, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

8. Troubleshooting: Strong analytical skills for diagnosing and resolving technical issues

**Soft Skills**

* **Communication:** Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users clearly

* **Problem-Solving:** Analytical thinking to find solutions to technical issues

* **Time Management:** Prioritizing tasks and managing time efficiently

* **Teamwork:** Ability to work effectively as part of a team

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor degree

**Experience**

* 1-2 years of progressive experience in Desktop Support

* Proven track record of managing hardware and software support

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports to: IT Manager

Acme Interiors is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

For company profile, please visit the website :- https://assystem-india.com/

 **Job Description**

Job Title

**ELV / ICT Engineer**

Department

MEP Engineering / Building Services

Reports To

ELV/ICT Sr Engineer/Lead /Assitant Manager / Design Manager

Job Purpose

The ELV / ICT Engineer shall be responsible for the **design, coordination, and documentation of Extra Low Voltage (ELV) and Information & Communication Technology (ICT) systems** as part of MEP consultancy services, ensuring compliance with project requirements, local codes, international standards, and client specifications.

Key Responsibilities

Design & Engineering

* Prepare **concept, schematic, detailed design, and tender drawings** for ELV/ICT systems, including:

  + Structured Cabling Systems (SCS – copper & fiber)
  + Data & Voice Networks
  + CCTV & Video Surveillance
  + Access Control Systems
  + Intrusion Detection / Burglar Alarm
  + Public Address & Voice Alarm (PA/VA)
  + IPTV / SMATV / MATV
  + Building Management System (BMS) interfaces
  + Audio-Visual (AV) systems
  + Intercom & Parking Management Systems
  + Airport systems and integration
* Develop **system architectures, riser diagrams, layouts, schematics, and single-line diagrams**.
* Perform **load calculations, bandwidth calculations, and equipment sizing**.
* Select appropriate equipment in line with **project specifications, standards, and budget**.

Standards & Compliance

* Ensure designs comply with:

  + Local authority regulations
  + International standards (TIA/EIA, ISO/IEC, IEC, NFPA, BS, EN)
  + Client and operator requirements
* Coordinate approvals with relevant authorities and stakeholders.

Coordination

* Coordinate ELV/ICT designs with:

  + Electrical, Mechanical, and Architectural disciplines
  + IT, Security, and AV specialists
  + BIM and CAD teams
* Resolve clashes and ensure integrated MEP design delivery.

Documentation & Deliverables

* Prepare:

  + Design reports
  + Technical specifications
  + Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
  + Cost estimates
  + Tender and IFC documentation
* Review shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements during construction phase.
* Support site teams with **technical clarifications and design revisions**.

Construction & Commissioning Support

* Provide technical support during installation, testing, and commissioning.
* Attend design coordination and site meetings.
* Review as-built drawings and system documentation.

Software & Tools

* AutoCAD / Revit (BIM preferred)
* MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* ELV design tools (e.g., cable calculation, network planning tools – advantage)

Experience

* **4–10 years** of experience in ELV/ICT design within MEP consultancy or contracting
* Experience in **Airports, metro, Railways and ports**
* Data center or mission-critical project experience is a plus

Skills & Competencies

* Strong understanding of ELV & ICT systems and integration
* Knowledge of MEP coordination processes
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and MEP drawings
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Time management and ability to handle multiple projects
* Problem-solving and attention to detail

Preferred Attributes

* Experience working in multidisciplinary design teams
* Familiarity with authority submission procedures
* Exposure to BIM-based design workflows

Qualifications

The **Change & Incident Management – ServiceDesk Plus L2** resource serves as the **central governance authority** for managing the end-to-end IT change and incident management lifecycle within the organization's ITSM framework, leveraging the **ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus** platform.

The primary objective of this role is to **govern, control, and optimize** all changes to IT systems, infrastructure, and services — ensuring every change is implemented in a controlled, risk-mitigated, and business-aligned manner. The individual acts as the **Single Point of Contact (SPOC)** for all RFCs (Requests for Change), responsible for evaluating impact, prioritizing changes, and driving structured decision-making through **CAB (Change Advisory Board)** governance — with the ultimate goal of minimizing service disruption, reducing operational risk, and ensuring full compliance with **ITIL-aligned processes**.

* **Documentation, Tracking & Audit Readiness** — Maintains accurate and complete records of all change requests, approvals, and outcomes within **ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus**, ensuring the organization remains audit-ready at all times.
* **Post-Change Review & Continuous Improvement** — Evaluates the success of changes post-implementation, analyzes outcomes, and recommends process refinements to enhance efficiency and minimize future disruptions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration** — Collaboration is a core component of this role. The Change Manager (L2) works closely with **L1** (providing guidance and oversight), **L3** (for escalation of complex changes and incidents), application owners, infrastructure teams, and vendors to ensure seamless execution, coordination, and resolution across all change and incident activities.

In the **incident management** capacity, the role additionally supports rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of IT incidents, ensuring service continuity in alignment with defined SLAs.

**The Change Manager (L2) ultimately ensures that every IT change delivers measurable business value while maintaining system stability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance — making it a critical governance and service delivery function within the IT infrastructure organization**

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
**Desktop Support Engineer Job Description**

**1. Provide Technical Support**

The primary role of a desktop support engineer is to provide help desk support to users within the organization who are having problems with their IT equipment or systems. This includes:

* Receiving requests via phone, email, chat, or ticketing systems
* Asking questions to properly diagnose reported issues
* Resolving common problems like network connectivity, password reset, email access, printer jamming, etc.
* Tracking issues from initial report to final resolution

**2. Troubleshoot Issues**

When users experience more complex system failures, desktop support engineers leverage their technical expertise to troubleshoot and determine root causes. This involves:

* Investigating error messages
* Reviewing system and application logs
* Testing software and hardware to pinpoint faulty component(s)
* Escalating to a specialized team if unable to diagnose
* Documenting details to share with engineering/development teams

**3. Install & Configure Systems**

Desktop support techs handle a variety of installation, configuration and maintenance tasks to optimize computer systems throughout the organization, including:

* Formatting, partitioning and imaging hard drives
* Upgrading or replacing hardware components like memory, network cards, video cards
* Installing operating systems, software drivers and applications
* Setting up new devices, printers, scanners, etc.
* Configuring system settings, security tools, VPN access etc.
* Performing preventative maintenance activities

**4. Provide Orientation & Training**

With their specialized expertise, desktop support technicians frequently hold orientation workshops and provide informal assistance to teach users about utilizing technologies effectively, including:

* Demoing how to use devices, operating systems, software, printers etc.
* Developing training materials and quick-start guides
* Conducting one-on-one and group training sessions
* Answering usage questions
* Ensuring users optimize and properly handle equipment

**5. Manage Inventory & Purchase Equipment**

Desktop support techs also handle inventory management and equipment procurement for their organizations. Their responsibilities related to this include:

* Tracking computers, devices, peripherals, components, and software licenses
* Identifying needs for additional supplies and hardware
* Researching products and vendors to find optimal solutions
* Coordinating with finance/procurement teams on purchases
* Installing and retiring equipment according to refresh cycles

**Skills Needed for Desktop Support Engineers**

In order to handle such a wide variety of critical responsibilities - providing tech support, troubleshooting complex issues, configuring systems, training users, and managing inventory - desktop support engineers need a diverse set of technical and interpersonal skills.

**Technical Skills**

* **Operating Systems:** Extensive knowledge of operating systems like Windows, macOS and Linux distributions
* **Hardware:** Understanding of computer components, mobile devices, printers, networks
* **Software:** Familiarity with productivity software, collaboration tools, security programs, etc.
* **Diagnostics:** Ability to review logs, run monitoring tools, conduct testing to pinpoint issues
* **Scripting:** Write scripts to automate tasks using languages like PowerShell
* **Networking Concepts:** Solid grasp of how LANs, WANs, Wi-Fi, VPNs etc. function

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Communication Skills:** Ability to interact with users clearly, politely and patiently
* **Collaboration:** Work with team members to solve issues and implement improvements
* **Training Abilities:** Skills to educate non-technical users on utilizing technology
* **Documentation:** Note details clearly for future reference
* **Time Management:** Prioritize and handle high volumes of support requests
* **Problem Solving:** Apply logical thinking to tackle technical challenges

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* This job role requires immediate joining. Can you join immediately?

Experience:

* Desktop support: 2 years (Required)
* TCP/IP: 1 year (Required)
* Active Directory: 1 year (Preferred)
* DHCP: 1 year (Preferred)

Summary:

Continuous Improvement:

Professional \& Technical Skills:

o Proven experience in implementing and managing Beyond Trust EPM solutions.  

o Strong knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems.  

o Experience with endpoint security and privilege management.  

Skills and Competencies:  

o Deep understanding of least privilege access principles and practices.  

o Proficiency in configuring and managing EPM policies and rules.  

o Familiarity with Active Directory, Group Policy, and other endpoint management tools.  

o Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.  

o Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  

o Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  

  

Additional Information:
  

o Relevant certifications such as Beyond Trust Certified Engineer (BTCE), Certified Information

**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The **Global Digital Marketing Automation Senior Specialist** is a deep, day\-to\-day expert in Marketo (or an equivalent platform such as Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot) who owns and optimizes our marketing automation engine. You’ll manage everything from advanced campaign builds and third\-party integrations to lead lifecycle strategy, event operations, and data governance — acting as the platform’s subject matter expert across the organization.


This is an ideal role for someone who has moved beyond basic email sends and wants to own the architecture, personalization, and performance of a marketing automation instance end\-to\-end.

 **Platform Management \& Campaign Execution**

* Manage, build, and optimize advanced Marketo core assets daily, including Smart Campaigns, Programs, Smart Lists, and flow logic
* Build and maintain universal, advanced Marketo Forms with progressive profiling, UTM parameter capture, hidden fields, and custom JavaScript for use across multiple workspaces
* Design and deploy standard landing page templates integrated with social sharing/network components
* Create reusable snippets for standardized footers and modular content blocks across landing pages and emails

 **Integrations \& Tech Stack**

* Integrate and manage third\-party platforms within Marketo, including webinar/virtual event tools (Zoom, ON24\), event registration platforms (Aventri, Certain), and mobile push notification channels
* Work with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, ensuring seamless lead/contact flow, field mapping, and sync configuration between Marketo and the CRM
* Troubleshoot CRM–Marketo sync issues (e.g., sync errors, field mismatches, duplicate records, blocked syncs) and implement fixes to maintain reliable, real\-time data flow \- Apply data enrichment practices — using enrichment tools, form\-based progressive profiling, and third\-party data append — to keep lead and contact records complete and up to date
* Demonstrate strong API familiarity, including configuring and managing API user roles/permissions, working with REST APIs for platform integrations, and troubleshooting API\- based data exchanges
* Test new services, integrations, and platform updates prior to launch

**Lead Lifecycle: Nurturing, Scoring \& Personalization**

* Build and maintain lead nurturing and lead scoring programs at both the global/instance level and individual campaign level
* Design and execute web personalization campaigns using dynamic content, web campaigns, and audience segments
* Develop lifecycle models and continuously refine scoring frameworks to improve lead quality and MQL conversion

**Data Management \& Segmentatio****n**

* Define and maintain audience segmentation strategies at both the client/account level and individual project level
* Own database hygiene, list imports, and data quality processes to maintain a clean, actionable database
* Support governance and documentation standards for data usage across programs

**Events \& Content Programs**

* Manage end\-to\-end program setup for trade shows, including personalized agendas and dynamic imagery per attendee/segment
* Build and manage webinar, online event, and gated content programs, including registration, reminder, and follow\-up flows
* Own program status tracking and post\-event hygiene (e.g., processing attendee/lead downloads, deduplication, list cleanup)

**Enablement, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as subject\-matter expert (SME) for the marketing automation platform, supporting troubleshooting, consultations, and new project readiness
* Provide training and documentation to internal teams, marketing ops representatives, and business stakeholders
* Partner with stakeholders to define requirements, governance standards, and rollout plans for new pilots or workspaces
* Support onboarding of new projects/workspaces onto the platform, including QA and functionality testing

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience managing a marketing automation platform (Marketo strongly preferred; Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot experience also considered)
* Marketo Certified Expert certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
* Proven experience building advanced Smart Campaigns, Programs, and multi\-step nurture/lead scoring logic
* Experience integrating Marketo with third\-party tools (webinar platforms, event management tools, CRM, mobile/push notification systems)
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), including lead/contact sync configuration and troubleshooting CRM–Marketo data flow issues
* Familiarity with data enrichment tools and practices to maintain accurate and complete records
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Experience with progressive profiling, dynamic/personalized content, and web segmentation
* Solid understanding of database segmentation, list hygiene, and data governance best practices
* Experience managing event marketing programs (webinars, trade shows, gated content) end\-to\-end
* Familiarity with Git or a similar version control tool (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) for tracking changes to custom scripts, JavaScript used in forms/landing pages, and code\-based assets
* Nice to have:
* Experience with Zoom, ON24, Aventri, or Certain integrations
* Experience supporting global, multi\-region marketing operations
* Exposure to lifecycle model design and cross\-functional campaign governance
* A/B testing and campaign performance reporting experience
* Exposure to CI/CD deployment practices for managing and releasing code\-based assets (custom scripts, templates,
* integrations) in a structured, version\-controlled way

  

Who You'll Work With


You will work within a Global Digital Marketing Automation and Email platform team across multiple geographies, collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, and platform teams. This role offers the opportunity to directly shape internal tools used globally across BCG.

  

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT** :

* Working with APIs — understanding of REST API concepts, managing API user roles/permissions, and supporting API\-driven integrations
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Strong communication skills with experience training stakeholders and documenting processes
* Detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and comfortable owning platform QA/testing before launches

 *"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*

*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*

*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: IT Technical Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support EngineerJob Overview

We are looking for a skilled **Technical Support Engineer** to provide technical assistance to customers, troubleshoot software and system issues, and ensure a smooth user experience. The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills, technical knowledge, and excellent communication abilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **technical support** to customers through email, chat, phone, and support tickets.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software, application, API, and system\-related issues.
* Investigate reported problems and identify the root cause.
* Reproduce bugs and work with development teams to resolve technical issues.
* Monitor and troubleshoot **API failures, integration issues, and data\-related problems**.
* Assist customers with account, configuration, access, and product\-related issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to development, DevOps, or engineering teams when required.
* Maintain accurate records of customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
* Create and maintain **technical documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides**.
* Monitor recurring issues and suggest improvements to reduce support requests.
* Test fixes and verify that reported issues have been resolved.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the resolution process.
* Assist with system monitoring and basic production support activities.

Required Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of **web applications, APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, and databases**.
* Basic knowledge of **Linux, networking, DNS, and cloud environments**.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as **Postman**.
* Ability to read and understand application logs and error messages.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and database troubleshooting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple support requests.
* Familiarity with ticketing and support management systems.

Good to Have

* Experience with **Node.js, JavaScript, React**, or other web technologies.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, Docker, or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
* Understanding of Git and software development workflows.
* Experience supporting SaaS products or B2B technology platforms.
* IT support or technical certifications.

Experience

**1–4 years** of experience in technical support, application support, software support, or a related field.

What We’re Looking For

A customer\-focused technical professional who can **diagnose issues quickly, communicate solutions clearly, collaborate with engineering teams, and ensure customer problems are resolved efficiently**.

Pay: ₹9,509\.67 \- ₹40,160\.25 per month

Work Location: In person
